name: Handles Into Finishing
summary: Warm up your handle, shoot off your footwork, finish long at the rim, then shoot tired to close it out.

drills.name: Front-Back V Dribbles
drills.summary: Control the ball front to back in a V shape with each hand.
steps: Get in a low stance with the ball in your right hand.
Push the ball out in front, then pull it back behind your heel in a V.
Keep the dribble at knee height for 30 seconds.
Switch to your left hand for 30 seconds.
Finish with front-back Vs into a crossover every third dribble.

drills.name: Short Corner Glide Jumpers
drills.summary: Glide from the short corner to the baseline and shoot on balance.
steps: Start in the short corner on the right side.
Self-toss the ball to the baseline spot, 12 feet out.
Glide to it, catch on a 1-2 step and shoot.
Get your rebound and repeat on the same side for 2 minutes.
Switch to the left side for the last 2 minutes.

drills.name: Long Stride Gather Finishes
drills.summary: Cover ground with a long last stride and finish high off the glass.
steps: Start at the top of the key.
Attack the right side with two hard dribbles.
Gather on a long stride outside the block and finish high off the glass.
Do 6 reps right, then 6 reps left with the left hand.
Last minute: alternate sides every rep.

drills.name: Arc-Line Burst Circuits
drills.summary: Sprint the arc, then shoot a mid-range jumper while tired.
steps: Start in the right corner with the ball.
Speed dribble along the arc to the left corner.
Turn and speed dribble back to the top of the key.
Pull up for an elbow jumper, get the rebound and jog back to a corner.
Go for 40 seconds, rest 20 seconds, and repeat 4 rounds.
